insight: In Sept 2025 acquired Woodstock Legal Services — believed to be the first purchase of a traditional law firm by an AI company.
name: Lawhive
tagline: AI-native UK law firm for affordable consumer legal help.
description: Lawhive is a UK consumer legal platform that pairs an AI legal assistant, "Lawrence," with SRA-regulated solicitors to handle everyday matters — divorce, employment, immigration, landlord and tenant, conveyancing, and small claims — at fixed, upfront fees. Lawrence drafts documents, runs research, and handles intake; human solicitors review and deliver the work.
edge: Consumer fixed-fee legal help: its AI 'Lawrence' (81% on the SQE) does routine work while SRA-regulated solicitors deliver — not enterprise lawyer tooling.
cons: You still pay solicitor fees per matter

references.title: Lawhive raises $60m to scale AI-native consumer law firm across the US
UK LegalTech startup Lawhive secures EUR 50 million to scale
